claim: PHDT reported about 116,275 line rooms and 10,379 temporary sheds for approximately 265,000 plantation-sector families in 2024.

metric.denominator: reported plantation-sector housing stock and families
metric.source_definition: sector inventory; family count is approximate

bounded_by: Does not establish that all line rooms are employment-tied tenancies or disproportionately located on unstable slopes.
notes: Corrects field premise: line-room housing exists and is extensive.
